title: Intel Loihi
description: Documented public neuromorphic chip (Intel) for the Neuromorphic System Designer capability area.
body:
Intel Loihi is a documented neuromorphic chip from Intel. Intel's research neuromorphic chip (Loihi 2: 1M neurons) running spiking networks at extreme efficiency.

How it works: It works by simulating an exponentially decaying loss curve with noise over the epoch budget and checking convergence.

Documented uses of this capability area include supercomputer job scheduling, cryptographic migration planning, chaos-engineering programs, and disaster-recovery verification.
